## Current signals

- WebNR remains a local-first browser reader and may be described as an independent browser-based alternative for some Legado users and web-first reading workflows. It is unaffiliated with Legado and is not an official Legado web client. Arbitrary Legado source JSON is not yet a drop-in WebNR runtime; compatibility claims remain tied to tested capability levels and versioned fixtures.
- `https://www.webnovel.win/` is the sole canonical public identity for documentation, reader-facing articles, search indexing, canonical tags, sitemap, and RSS. `https://app.webnovel.win/` is the reader application runtime; `https://autoarchive.github.io/webNR/` is an attributable documentation build mirror only.
- Pull request #113 expands `Progression & LitRPG Publisher Discovery Starter` from three to six first-party discovery destinations: Aethon Books, Mountaindale Press, Portal Books, Wraithmarked Creative, Shadow Alley Press, and Timeless Wind Publishing. The admitted capability remains static link-only: WebNR stores origin URLs plus WebNR-authored descriptions/labels and does not copy catalog metadata, covers, prices, ratings, reviews, release schedules, author biographies, retailer data, accounts, or book text; it performs no origin API/HTML/feed/search polling.
- The 2026-08-24 source program screened five previously untracked candidate families: Wraithmarked Creative, Shadow Alley Press, Timeless Wind Publishing, Royal Guard Publishing, and The Legion Publishers. Wraithmarked Creative, Shadow Alley Press, and Timeless Wind Publishing received complete first-party admission review and shipped in #113. Royal Guard Publishing and The Legion Publishers remain deferred because the audited first-party surfaces were primarily submission/publisher-oriented rather than stable reader catalogs. Rotating health review rechecked Aethon Books, Mountaindale Press, and Portal Books; all remained publicly reachable.
- Pull request #114 is the latest substantial reader asset. Its 2026-08-24 Progression Fantasy/LitRPG recommendation-method guide contains more than 10,000 Chinese main-text characters, 22 academic references plus 24 platform/community/first-party sources, multiple fresh public-web research rounds, Sider Scholar research, current Royal Road and Reddit evidence, counterexamples/boundaries, a six-dimensional demand-vector method, a four-layer evidence chain, and an original four-factor recommendation-confidence synthesis. The next scheduled substantial asset is the 2026-08-26 fanfiction discovery topic.
- The currently accepted maintained source set is: WebNR Originals, Aozora Bunko Starter, Standard Ebooks Starter, Project Madurai Starter, English Serial Platforms Starter, Project Gutenberg Starter, Global Grey Starter, Online Books Page Starter, Wolne Lektury Starter, Wikisource Starter, English Web-Fiction Discovery Starter, Chinese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Japanese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Korean Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, and Progression & LitRPG Publisher Discovery Starter. Rights/access behavior remains source-specific; several maintained catalogs are intentionally link-only.
- The deferred source queue includes Project Runeberg, StoryWeaver, Lit2Go, Perseus Digital Library, Baen Free Library, LitFic, Betakyte, Hungry's Hedgerow, Ream, Laterpress, Fanqie / 番茄小说, Changpei / 长佩文学, 潇湘书院, 红袖读书, SF轻小说 / 菠萝包轻小说, 刺猬猫, ハーメルン, Nolaノベル, ノベモア, ノベルアップ＋, pixiv novels, 카카오페이지 / KakaoPage, 조아라 / Joara, OneStory, Bookcube, MrBlue, Ascendant Reads, ProgFans, Royal Guard Publishing, and The Legion Publishers.
